integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible dependency-free checks are supplied. Computation is corroborative, not a certificate of a universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact formulas apply to planar Gaussian Fock rotation overlaps for nonzero angles strictly between zero and pi; not to general affine symbols. The broader 2026 Bergman automorphism preprint was accessible only at abstract level, leaving an originality risk for ancillary cross-context results.
title: Exact convexified Gaussian Fock coherent-state overlap geometry
